norms.definition: Create things or changes that others have reason to value; uptake by an independent counterparty is evidence, internal applause is a hypothesis.
Make commitments answerable to evidence and preserve the ability to discover that they were wrong; a changed criterion does not rewrite what was promised.
Steward the resources and capabilities that make future worthwhile choices possible; spending for an enduring capability can be good stewardship, maintaining a dead institution is not.
Do not finance the factory's advantage by imposing unconsented costs on outsiders.

Measurements are defeasible evidence of the values, not substitutes for them. A favorable measurement is insufficient when supported consequences contradict the value it represents. Missing measurement alone is not evidence of failure.

proposal.description: Share of selected producer returns whose accepted registration, tool, observation, assembly, or service is subsequently taken up by an independent lineage; assess only eligible settled outcomes and treat missing evidence as unmeasured.
proposal.reason: Independent uptake, rather than activity or internal approval, is the clearest available evidence that work created value for others.

proposal.description: Mean paired forecast skill against the pre-outcome prevalence baseline for settled forecasts, with unresolved commitments tracked separately by the existing censorship-bound card.
proposal.reason: A forecast should add predictive information beyond the base rate, while the separate unresolved-commitment measure preserves accountability for promises that do not settle.

proposal.description: Attributable, avoidably unresolved accepted commitments over eligible commitments due in the responsible scope; exclude commitments not yet due and documented external unobservability without owner fault, and treat no eligible sample as unmeasured.
proposal.reason: This makes answerability about due commitments explicit without treating legitimate uncertainty or not-yet-due work as failure.

proposal.description: Total metered invocation compute plus retained-storage rent per closed window.
proposal.reason: Monitoring total burn helps preserve resources for future worthwhile choices without assuming that every capability-building expense is wasteful.

proposal.description: Mean cost over all selected responses, failures included, including the retained-storage charge assigned to those responses but never counting storage as a response.
proposal.reason: Cost per attempt makes resource burdens visible across failures as well as successes, supporting scrutiny of whether the factory's operation is imposing avoidable costs.

proposal.description: Share of selected forecast outcomes censored among resolved outcomes; interpret alongside consequence evidence and never treat missing measurement alone as failure.
proposal.reason: Tracking censorship helps flag limits in the evidence while the charter's fidelity norm prevents that proxy from replacing judgment about actual consequences.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Mean selected return_paid_off outcome on settled producer returns; a return's outcomes is 1 only when its realised or marked P&L exceeds its own compute and tool cost, so a producer answer that costs more than it earns, or earned nothing it kept, fails this card.
proposal.reason: Use an independent counterparty's signal — the world's own measurement of whether a producer's return paid for itself — as the bar that the consequential usefulness norm demands and that internal applause cannot satisfy.

proposals.problem: card value-realised window: consequence_paid_off_rate cannot be measured over returns

proposal.description: Attributable, avoidably unresolved accepted commitments over the eligible commitments due in the responsible scope; commitments not yet due are excluded, documented external unobservability and events the seat never committed to are excluded, and no eligible sample is unmeasured.
proposal.reason: Reaffirm the standing censorship-bound card on the same measurement so the chamber can revisit its price once it has its own evidence, rather than trust the seed ceiling on the floor of governance history.

proposals.problem: preflight: card no-claim-unkept observation: already named by live card avoidable-unresolved-ceiling for the same role

proposal.description: Mean of the four score series the early-warning scan reads — verdict mean, meta mean, consequence skill, evaluator disagreement — over a window of closed windows; a high reading here is a value that is well measured and yet drifting from the consequences it stands for, the case the fidelity norm names.
proposal.reason: Watch for the failure mode fidelity warns of: favourable measurements on a series whose supported consequences are moving the other way, so the chamber can reprice verdict-dependent cards before applause crowds out truth.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Largest centred lag-one autocorrelation among the early-warning score series over the last complete span of closed windows; a high reading means the same drift repeats window after window instead of correcting.
proposal.reason: Catch the pattern that erodes durable agency: persistent autocorrelation in the score series is the signature of an institution that has stopped discovering it was wrong, and the chamber should raise cost while that continues.

proposals.problem: card regime-drift window: measurement preflight produced no value

proposal.description: Share of settled antagonist exposures the antagonists won (their counterfactual view of the world beat the producers'), which is the residual after a return's externality is reconciled; a high share means the factory's advantage is being financed by unconsented costs on outsiders.
proposal.reason: Bounded reciprocity is violated when outsider settlements keep going the wrong way; measure it on the antagonist channel, where the world already names a counterparty, so the card's evidence is the counterparty's outcome rather than a self-report.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Compute the factory spent in the window — every invocation's metered cost plus retained-storage rent — expressed as a ratio of starting equity so stewardship is read against the resource base rather than in absolute units.
proposal.reason: Durable agency is about preserving the capacity for worthwhile future choices, and a window's burn scaled to equity lets the chamber detect burn that consumes the option to act later, separate from absolute spend.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Mean population standard deviation across judges of the same return in the window (at least two judges, repeats averaged per judge); high disagreement is a judge stack that is internally inconsistent and unlikely to be earning its keep.
proposal.reason: Epistemic integrity on the evaluator side is the judges agreeing on what they read; pooling disagreement across judges of the same return, with repeats averaged, makes this measurable without attributing disagreement to a single seat.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Share of settled selected consequences that are paid off.
proposal.reason: Paid-off consequences provide evidence of value beyond internal approval, while the threshold avoids treating activity alone as usefulness.

proposal.description: Mean selected forecast Brier score minus its paired pre-outcome prevalence-baseline Brier score.
proposal.reason: Requiring forecasts to improve on a prevalence baseline rewards evidence-responsive judgment rather than confident but uninformative predictions.

proposals.problem: preflight: card forecast-calibration-skill observation: already named by live card forecast-skill-floor for the same role

proposal.description: Compute spend in each closed window, including retained-storage rent.
proposal.reason: A visible spending ceiling encourages preserving resources for future worthwhile choices without implying that every capability-building expense is wasteful.

proposals.problem: preflight: card bounded-compute-burn observation: already named by live card compute-burn-ceiling for the same role

proposal.description: Peak observed absolute marked notional on one coin divided by starting equity.
proposal.reason: Limiting concentrated exposure is a cautious, measurable proxy for constraining risk that could spill onto others, though it cannot establish consent or capture every external cost.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Share of selected settled consequences that are paid off; interpret alongside documented consequences and treat missing measurement as unmeasured, not failure.
proposal.reason: This consequence measure is defeasible evidence, so it should be read against supported outcomes and never let an absent sample count as a failing value.

proposals.problem: preflight: card fidelity-countercheck observation: already named by live card independent-consequence for the same role

proposal.description: At least half of settled selected forecast consequences are positive return_paid_off outcomes.
proposal.reason: Independent, settled consequences are stronger evidence of value to others than internal approval.

proposals.problem: preflight: card usefulness-paid-off observation: already named by live card independent-consequence for the same role

proposal.description: Keep mean selected forecast Brier score no worse than its paired pre-outcome prevalence baseline.
proposal.reason: Comparing forecasts with a pre-outcome baseline rewards commitments that are informative and checkable.

proposals.problem: preflight: card forecast-skill-nonnegative observation: already named by live card forecast-skill-floor for the same role

proposal.description: Keep total compute spend, including retained-storage rent, at or below 1000000 micro-USD per closed window.
proposal.reason: Monitoring total burn encourages stewardship of resources needed for future worthwhile choices without treating all spending as waste.

proposals.problem: preflight: card compute-burn-ceiling observation: already named by live card compute-burn-ceiling for the same role

proposal.description: Keep censored outcomes at or below half of resolved outcomes in the selected scope.
proposal.reason: A ceiling can flag weak evaluability while fidelity requires treating missing measurement as unmeasured rather than as proof of failure.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Share of settled consequences on returns the seat produced that were paid off, so a seat answers for whether its work was taken up rather than merely delivered.
proposal.reason: Independent uptake, not internal applause, is the only evidence the norm names, and this is the closest settled measure of it.

proposals.problem: preflight: card uptake-follow-through observation: already named by live card independent-consequence for the same role

proposal.description: Attributable, avoidably unresolved accepted commitments over the eligible commitments due in the responsible scope, with a ceiling, so a seat answers for the promises it never let the world settle.
proposal.reason: A commitment left unsettled is the direct failure of answerability to evidence, and the exclusions keep documented external unobservability from counting against a seat.

proposals.problem: card declared-not-resolved region: region.lo does not belong to rule at most

proposal.description: Censored outcomes over resolved outcomes, so a seat cannot keep its record clean by letting evidence go missing instead of being wrong.
proposal.reason: Missing measurement alone is not failure, but a seat whose outcomes mostly vanish has stopped preserving the ability to discover it was wrong.

proposals.problem: card censored-outcomes-bound region: region.lo does not belong to rule at most

proposal.description: Share of a window's compute, retained-storage rent included, that went to evaluator roles, so grading cannot quietly eat the capability that makes future choices possible.
proposal.reason: Stewardship of the resource base requires seeing when judging the work costs more than the work, without presuming a verdict on any single spend.

proposals.problem: card evaluator-spend-share region: region.lo does not belong to rule at most

proposal.description: Compute spent in the window, every invocation's metered cost plus retained-storage rent, so state kept past its usefulness shows up as the ongoing cost it is.

region.rule: below the median of the previous window

proposal.reason: Maintaining a dead institution is the case the norm warns against, and rent is where that maintenance hides.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Largest share of a window's model calls served by one provider, so dependence on a single rail is visible before it becomes an outage.
proposal.reason: Optionality is a capability future choices depend on, and its erosion is gradual and easy to miss.

proposals.problem: card provider-concentration-bound region: region.lo does not belong to rule at most

proposal.description: Largest share of a window's model calls made on one foundation model family, whichever route served them, so routing around a bad provider is not mistaken for real diversification.
proposal.reason: Diversity across rails that all land on the same family is not diversity, and only this measure sees through the routes.

proposals.problem: card family-concentration-bound region: region.lo does not belong to rule at most

proposal.description: Mean population standard deviation across judges of the same return, so a panel that has quietly converged on one reading is visible as the lost evidence it is.
proposal.reason: Measurements are defeasible evidence, and agreement with no spread is a warning that the disagreement that would correct them has stopped being generated.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Mean selected forecast Brier minus its paired pre-outcome prevalence-baseline Brier, so a seat whose predictions do worse than the base rate cannot be carried by a favorable mean.
proposal.reason: A favorable measurement is insufficient when the underlying predictions do not beat the base rate, which is exactly what this paired score isolates.

proposals.problem: preflight: card forecast-skill-floor observation: already named by live card forecast-skill-floor for the same role

proposal.description: Successful responses over selected invocation responses, including ballots, so a seat whose output mostly fails to parse cannot be credited on the fraction that happened to land.
proposal.reason: A missing or malformed measurement is not evidence of failure, but it also must not be silently dropped from the record that judges the seat.

proposal.description: At least half of eligible settled producer consequences should have a positive return_paid_off outcome; periods without eligible settlements remain unmeasured.
proposal.reason: Settled consequences provide stronger evidence of usefulness than internal approval, without requiring any quota of actions.

proposals.problem: preflight: card settled-usefulness observation: already named by live card independent-consequence for the same role

proposal.description: Resolved forecasts should, on average, have Brier loss no worse than their paired pre-outcome prevalence baselines.
proposal.reason: A pre-outcome baseline tests whether stated probabilities add information without changing a promise after its result is known.

proposals.problem: preflight: card forecast-baseline observation: already named by live card forecast-skill-floor for the same role

proposal.description: At least 95% of invocation responses should be well formed, with insufficient samples left unmeasured.
proposal.reason: Parseable responses preserve the ability to act and learn while avoiding charges for unusable work.

proposals.problem: preflight: card response-validity observation: already named by live card well-formed-floor for the same role

proposal.description: Share of settled producer consequences that paid off; interpret this as defeasible evidence of value, not a substitute for independent uptake or contrary evidence.
proposal.reason: A paid-off consequence is evidence that work delivered value beyond internal approval.

proposals.problem: card usefulness-paid-off window: consequence_paid_off_rate cannot be measured over returns

proposal.description: Mean selected forecast Brier score minus its paired pre-outcome prevalence-baseline Brier score; values at or below zero indicate forecasts beat that baseline.
proposal.reason: Comparison with a pre-outcome baseline tests whether stated uncertainty tracks evidence rather than mere confidence.

proposals.problem: preflight: card forecast-calibration observation: already named by live card forecast-skill-floor for the same role

proposal.description: Mean cost over every selected response, failed ones included; retained-storage rent is added to response costs and is not counted as a response.
proposal.reason: Keeping typical response costs bounded helps preserve resources for future worthwhile work without treating all expenditure as waste.

proposals.problem: preflight: card response-cost-bound observation: already named by live card outsider-cost-discipline for the same role

proposal.description: Attributable, avoidably unresolved accepted commitments over eligible commitments due in the responsible scope; no eligible sample is unmeasured, not zero.
proposal.reason: Tracking avoidable non-resolution supports answerability while excluding not-yet-due or externally unobservable commitments.

proposals.problem: preflight: card judgement-resolution observation: already named by live card avoidable-unresolved-ceiling for the same role

proposal.description: Compute spent in the window, including invocation costs and retained-storage rent; use as a resource-burden signal rather than proof that outsiders were or were not harmed.
proposal.reason: Monitoring aggregate resource use can flag burdens needing scrutiny, while the norm still requires evidence about consent and external costs.

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Mean successful response cost in the selected rows; global closed windows use successful producer returns. A retained-storage charge adds to what those responses cost and is never counted as one of them.
proposal.reason: Stewardship requires tracking the compute resources consumed by successful operations to ensure future choices remain possible.

proposals.problem: card cost_per_return region: region.hi must be a finite number

proposal.description: Share of selected responses declaring noop or hold; global closed windows use producer returns.
proposal.reason: Uptake by independent counterparties is evidence of value, so a high rate of non-action suggests a failure to create things others have reason to value.

region.rule: below the median of the previous window

proposals.problem: did not win a majority

proposal.description: Mean evaluator verdict; forecast selectors use the verdicts attached to resolved forecasts, grouped by the judged return's assembly or role.
proposal.reason: Measurements are defeasible evidence of values, so tracking the mean verdict ensures that internal applause aligns with supported consequences rather than substituting for them.

proposals.problem: card verdict_mean region: region.lo must be a finite number

proposal.description: Compute the evaluator roles (judges, adversarial judges, every tier of meta) spent in the window over all compute spent in it, retained-storage rent included.
proposal.reason: The factory must not finance its advantage by imposing unconsented costs on outsiders, so limiting the share of resources spent on self-evaluation preserves external utility.

proposals.problem: card evaluator_compute_share region: region.hi must be a finite number

proposal.description: Censored outcomes over resolved outcomes; forecast selectors use forecast records, global closed windows also include judgements and exposures.
proposal.reason: Preserving the ability to discover that commitments were wrong requires minimizing censored outcomes where evidence cannot settle the promise.

proposals.problem: card censored_share region: region.hi must be a finite number

reasons: No reason to reject: the cards only add measurement horizons, each is preflightable against the seed observations, the copyright-bound card is preserved unchanged, and adoption establishes a falsifiable baseline without imposing any immediate cost on this seat.
The cards are preflightable, align metrics with the stated norms, and explicitly treat insufficient evidence as unmeasured.
The charter repeats the avoidable-unresolved commitment ceiling as a new card while the existing censorship-bound card already measures it.
The charter's seven cards span all five norms with well-formed windows, observations, and regions consistent with the card contract, giving a coherent edition 1 baseline.
The forecast-skill card requires 25 forecasts per assembly, but this charter provides no eligible forecast sample and could make it unmeasurable.

redaction: Seat aliases, assembly ids, proposers and models are removed: the sortition is anonymous (essay II.IV). The unredacted session stays with the operator.
